instruction.name: vftintl.l.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in lower part of every 128-bit vector of `a` to signed 64-bit integer, using current rounding mode specified in `fscr`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
